title: The green coat, taken in
logline: The folding chair on the dock at dusk without the green coat over it for the first time, and through the shack's door a hook with the coat on it. Somebody took it in. The chair bare. Four days before the rings.

panels.composition: A folding chair on a dock at dusk with nothing over its back, and through a shingle shack's open door a green coat hanging on a hook inside.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a folding chair on a wooden dock at dusk with nothing over its back and through a shingle shack's open door a green coat hanging on a hook inside, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
